name: c12d-check
description: Step C12d books check: 420 s at MAX (seed 5), the whole dish lit, the default springs plus springs of every kind, N (60 s), a wash (100 s), a resize (150 s), G (200 s), a resize back (220 s), new springs (240 s), the electrons' switches and knobs (fluorescence, photochemistry, the glow, the depth and shares), lipids, membranes, engines and the chemistry off and on at runtime (250 to 350 s), a snapshot saved and loaded at once (380 s); atoms and charge rounding must stay 0

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.35, 'soap', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.65, 'oil', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.7, v.cssH * 0.65, 'emulsion', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.5, 'linker', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.3, 'ions', 120); return moire.matter.springs.length
const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.4, 'light', 200); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'heavy', 200); return 1

{ const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.5, 'light'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.5, 'heavy'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.3, 'emulsion'); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.7, 'soap'); } return moire.matter.springs.length
moire.electrons.params.fluor = true; moire.electrons.params.photo = false; moire.electrons.look.on = false; return 'photochemistry off, glow not drawn'
moire.electrons.params.photo = true; moire.electrons.look.on = true; moire.electrons.params.kAbs = 5; moire.electrons.params.yRx = 0.9; moire.electrons.params.yFl = 0.9; return 'depth 5, shares 0.9'
moire.electrons.params.kAbs = 1; moire.electrons.params.yRx = 0.5; moire.electrons.params.yFl = 0.4; moire.lipids.params.graze = false; return 'knobs back, graze off'
moire.lipids.params.graze = true; moire.lipids.params.on = false; return 'lipids off'
moire.lipids.params.on = true; moire.membrane.params.on = false; return 'membrane chemistry off'
moire.membrane.params.on = true; moire.eat.params.engines = false; moire.eat.params.burner = true; return 'engines off, everyone burns (not available with electrons)'
moire.eat.params.engines = true; moire.eat.params.burner = false; moire.matter.chem.on = false; return 'chemistry off'
moire.matter.chem.on = true; moire.light.params.mode = 'spot'; return 'all on, spotlight'
const S = await moire.snapshot({ grid: true }); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, rounding: r.rounding, electrons: S.electrons }
